name: eduventure
description: Eduventure 2.0 — Next.js web + NestJS API monorepo

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,yellow "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.db:migrate: npm --prefix apps/api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: npm --prefix apps/api exec prisma db seed
